segments.text: BEhold (nowe) prayſe the Lord all ye ſeruauntes of the Lorde, ye that by night ſtand in the houſe of the Lorde: (euen in the courtes of the houſe of our God.)
Lifte vp youre handes in the Sanctuary: and prayſe the Lorde.
The Lord that made heauē and earth: geue thee bleſſing out of Sion.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning, is nowe, and euer. &c.
